subject: error loading ggplot2 package in Shiny Server App

messages.author: cfc13ef6e1468bb5
messages.subject: error loading ggplot2 package in Shiny Server App
parts:
I have a Shiny Server app which runs fine locally but is failing when I run it on a Shiny Server on Ubuntu 14.04 (AWS EC2 instance).  The app renders the ui.R portion correctly but then grays out and disconnects from the server.

I have isolated the issue to the "library(ggplot2)" line of code because if I comment out this line of code the app does not gray out but instead says:

An error has occurred. Check your logs or contact the app author for clarification.

When I look at my logs I can see the error is related to not recognizing the "ggplot" function which makes sense since the library wasn't loaded.

So when I try to load the ggplot2 package at the beginning the app grays out but when I comment that line out the app runs but hits an error at the end when the code tries to invoke the ggplot function to render the plot.

When I log into R on Ubuntu as the "shiny" user and enter the library(ggplot2) command I get the following error related to another package that it appears ggplot2 is dependent upon:

Error in loadNamespace(j <- i[[1L]], c(lib.loc, .libPaths()), versionCheck = vI[[j]]) : 

  there is no package called ‘tibble’

Error: package or namespace load failed for ‘ggplot2’


When I run install.packages("ggplot2") as the Shiny user in R I get this error also related to tibble:

ERROR: compilation failed for package ‘tibble’

* removing ‘/home/shiny/R/x86_64-pc-linux-gnu-library/3.3/tibble’


The downloaded source packages are in

‘/tmp/RtmpYoPGCG/downloaded_packages’

Warning message:

In install.packages("tibble") :

  installation of package ‘tibble’ had non-zero exit status


This is my sessionInfo():

R version 3.3.2 (2016-10-31)

Platform: x86_64-pc-linux-gnu (64-bit)

Running under: Ubuntu 14.04.5 LTS


locale:

 [1] LC_CTYPE=en_US.UTF-8       LC_NUMERIC=C              

 [3] LC_TIME=en_US.UTF-8        LC_COLLATE=en_US.UTF-8    

 [5] LC_MONETARY=en_US.UTF-8    LC_MESSAGES=en_US.UTF-8   

 [7] LC_PAPER=en_US.UTF-8       LC_NAME=C                 

 [9] LC_ADDRESS=C               LC_TELEPHONE=C            

[11] LC_MEASUREMENT=en_US.UTF-8 LC_IDENTIFICATION=C       


attached base packages:

[1] stats     graphics  grDevices utils     datasets  methods   base     


loaded via a namespace (and not attached):

[1] colorspace_1.3-2 scales_0.4.1     lazyeval_0.2.0   plyr_1.8.3      

[5] tools_3.3.2      gtable_0.2.0     Rcpp_0.12.1      grid_3.3.2      

[9] munsell_0.4.3  


This makes it seem like I can't run ggplot2 on Ubuntu using this version of R.  Is that true?  Any ideas how to get my app working?


Thanks,


Jared
